summary: A chair offers the sponsor a summer study as the session runs short.
realLife: Tennessee chair Rusty Crowe proposed studying medical marijuana over the summer, and sponsor Steve Dickerson deferred despite wanting action sooner.
inGame: study-formed records the sponsor, members and charge. study-reported carries the eventual finding.

turns.what: The sponsor declines the study and asks the chair to put the bill to a vote.
turns.pulledBy: The sponsor believes enough members are present to pass it.
turns.writesBack: The committee faces the original bill again.

turns.what: The study reports after the deadline for action in this session.
turns.pulledBy: The reporting date falls after adjournment.
turns.writesBack: The finding is available when a sponsor files next session.
